```{r}
dir1<-"./data/extern/pit/"
folders<-list.files(path=dir1)
for (i in 1:length(folders)){
  dir2<-paste0(dir1,folders[i],"/")
  files<-list.files(path=dir2)
  for (j in 1:length(files)){
    dir3<-paste0(dir2,files[j])
    file<-read.table(dir3,header=FALSE,sep='\t')
    file<-as.data.frame(file[substr(file$V1, 0, 1) == "D", ])
    file<-as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(file[,1], "\\s+", 12))[,c(2,3,6)]
    colnames(file)<-c("Date","Time","tag_code")
    file$event_date_time_value<-as.POSIXct(paste(file$Date,file$Time),format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS")
    file<-file %>% dplyr::select(-Date,-Time)
    file$event_site_code_value<-sub("\\s+[^ ]+$", "", files[j])
    if (i==1 & j==1){data=file} else{data=rbind(data,file)}
  }
}
data$event_site_code_value=tolower(data$event_site_code_value)
data$antenna_id="01"
data$antenna_group_configuration_value=100
data<-data[startsWith(data$tag_code,"9")==TRUE,]
```

```{r}
comp_obs <- compress(cth_file = data)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
gate_onder <- read_excel("./data/extern/valves.xlsx", sheet = 1)
gate_onder <- gate_onder %>%
  rename(date_time = 'Date Time',
         opening_onder = 'Valve 1') %>%
  dplyr::select(date_time, opening_onder)
gate_onder$date_time <- round_date(ymd_hms(gate_onder$date_time),unit="1 second")

gate_boven <- read_excel("./data/extern/valves.xlsx", sheet = 2)
gate_boven <- gate_boven %>%
  rename(date_time = 'Date time',
         opening_boven = 'Value') %>%
  dplyr::select(date_time, opening_boven)
gate_boven$date_time <- round_date(ymd_hms(gate_boven$date_time),unit="1 second")
```

```{r}
#Determine the time interval by determining the earliest and latest measurement
start<-min(c(min(gate_onder$date_time,na.rm=TRUE),
             min(gate_boven$date_time,na.rm=TRUE)
             ))
stop<-max(c(max(gate_onder$date_time,na.rm=TRUE),
            max(gate_boven$date_time,na.rm=TRUE)
            ))
seq=as.data.frame(seq(start,stop,by=1)) #Time interval with steps of one second
colnames(seq)="date_time"
gate <- left_join(seq,gate_onder[which(duplicated(gate_onder$date_time)==FALSE),], by=c("date_time")) #Merge all data with this time interval
gate <- left_join(gate,gate_boven[which(duplicated(gate_boven$date_time)==FALSE),], by=c("date_time")) #Merge all data with this time interval
gate$opening_onder<-na_interpolation(gate$opening_onder,option ="linear")
gate$opening_boven<-na_interpolation(gate$opening_boven,option ="linear")
gate$open_onder=FALSE
gate$open_onder[which(gate$opening_onder>2.55)]=TRUE
gate$open_boven=FALSE 
gate$open_boven[which(gate$opening_boven>2.55)]=TRUE
```

```{r}
gate$open_onder_lag<-dplyr::lag(gate$open_onder)
open_onder<-which(gate$open_onder!=gate$open_onder_lag & gate$open_onder==FALSE & gate$open_onder_lag==TRUE)
gate$onder_periode=NA
k=1
for (i in open_onder-1){
  gate$onder_periode[i]=k
  k=k+1
}
gate <- gate %>% fill(onder_periode, .direction = 'up') %>% dplyr::select(-open_onder_lag)
gate$since_onder_event<-with(rle(gate$onder_periode), sequence(lengths))
gate$since_onder_event[which(gate$open_onder==TRUE)]=0

gate$open_boven_lag<-dplyr::lag(gate$open_boven)
open_boven<-which(gate$open_boven!=gate$open_boven_lag & gate$open_boven==FALSE & gate$open_boven_lag==TRUE)
gate$boven_periode=NA
k=1
for (i in open_boven-1){
  gate$boven_periode[i]=k
  k=k+1
}
gate <- gate %>% fill(boven_periode, .direction = 'up') %>% dplyr::select(-open_boven_lag)
gate$since_boven_event<-with(rle(gate$boven_periode), sequence(lengths))
gate$since_boven_event[which(gate$open_boven==TRUE)]=0
```
